config.inlineBlame.enabled: Show who last changed the current line, when, and why — at the end of the line. Off by default.
command.saveViewAsDefault.title: Gitline: Save Current View as Default
command.openRepository.title: Gitline: Open Repository…
config.repositories.searchDepth: How many folder levels below each workspace folder Gitline looks for Git repositories (0 = only the folder itself). VS Code's own Git looks one level down; the default here, 2, also finds `research/json-editor` under a parent folder. Hidden folders and symbolic links are not entered.
config.repositories.ignoredFolders: Folder names Gitline never looks into when searching for repositories.
config.graph.defaultView: Which history the graph opens with. Applies when the panel is created (window start or reload); a view you pick in the sidebar stays until then. Leave unset to reopen the last view you used.
config.graph.defaultView.all: Every local and remote branch and tag. Commits not on the current branch are dimmed.
config.graph.defaultBranches: Branches for `#gitline.graph.defaultView#` = `selected`: local (`main`), remote (`origin/main`) or tag names, or patterns where `*` matches within one path segment (`origin/team/*`). Names that don't exist in a repository are skipped. Tip: Ctrl/Cmd+click branches in the sidebar, then run **Gitline: Save Current View as Default**.
config.graph.columns: Columns shown at the right of each commit in the graph. You can also right-click the graph's column header to show or hide them. In a narrow pane, author, date and hash still give way to the message.
config.graph.columns.author: Show the commit author.
config.graph.dateFormat: How commit dates read in the graph. Hover a date for the other form.
config.graph.detailsLocation: Where the commit details (changed files) sit next to the graph.
config.graph.detailsLocation.auto: Below the graph when the panel is narrow (under 640 px) and tall enough, otherwise to the right.
config.graph.detailsLocation.right: Always to the right of the graph.
config.graph.highlightCurrentBranch: Tint the commits of the current branch (reachable from `HEAD`) when the graph also shows other branches, e.g. in the All branches view.
config.performance.suggestCommitGraph: When the history of a large repository loads slowly because it has no commit-graph file, offer to build one (`git commit-graph write --reachable`). Gitline never builds it without asking.
config.graph.messageAlignment.lane: Right after the lanes of its own row, close to its node.
config.graph.messageAlignment.column: In one column, after the widest point of the graph.
